skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: After Storm
skins.content: Test Collection Series/After Storm. Frost inevitably gives way to a clear day. Ch'en Hui-chieh patrols the city in her first L.G.D. uniform, re-inspecting the metropolis both familiar and foreign to her.
skins.quote: The warm sun pierces through the clouds, and what were once the vestiges of frost have now, with the advent of spring, become the first sign of the nurturing land nourishing its children.

skins.name: Ageless Afterglow
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Ageless Afterglow. Handcrafted by Lungmen artisans, this tailor-made dress is comfortable, beautiful, and accentuates one's figure. By popular request, it has been made to be a bit sportier than the standard line.
skins.usage: The dress Ch'en wore to a New Year's event.
skins.quote: Defeating the passage of time is harder than defeating foes on the battlefield.
